Open the [page-copy failure flow](http://maker:4001/snapshot-failure.html). Confirm that the bookmark remains safely saved despite the unavailable copy, then select **Try again**.

The page-copy line should change to the approved saved-copy state after the retry succeeds. I’ve assumed a capture failure never blocks or removes the bookmark and that retrying is your choice rather than happening silently. Does this recovery feel right?
